About

Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Day Care SPF 30 counteracts the ageing process, fills deeper wrinkles, and intensively moisturises for firmer-looking skin. This Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Day Care SPF 30 Refill contains 90% less plastic compared to the regular Eucerin Face Care Jar.
NART: 99542-09900-00

Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Day Care SPF 30 for all skin types counteracts the ageing process. It fills deeper wrinkles and intensively moisturises for firmer-looking skin. With SPF 30 and a UVA filter, it protects skin from the premature ageing caused by sun damage.

Eucerin’s unique blend of high and low molecular Hyaluronic Acid delivers a targeted approach to visibly plumping even deep wrinkles*. High Molecular Hyaluronic Acid improves hydration and smooths the outermost layers of skin, while Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid, which is 40 times smaller**.

This Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Day Care SPF 30 Refill contains 90% less plastic compared to the regular Eucerin Face Care jar. By using this refill, you can help reduce plastic waste and contribute towards a more sustainable product cycle. Compatible with all Eucerin Face Care jars.

* Penetrates further into the epidermal skin layers where deeper wrinkles originate.

**Compared to the High Molecular Hyaluronic Acid also used in the formula.

How to Use

- Please ensure that all components are dry before inserting the refill. - Remove the lid and insert the refill into the jar. - Apply in the morning to a well-cleansed face, neck, and décolleté. - Gently massage into the skin. - Avoid contact with the eyes. - For best results, use in combination with Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Firming Serum and Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Firming Night Care. - Follow with Eucerin Sun Fluid Photoageing Control SPF 50 when extra sun protection is needed.

Main findings

Clinical Formula

Hyaluronic acid

Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.

Learn More
Glycine Saponin

Glycine Saponin, also known as Glycine Soja Germ Extract, is an active ingredient extracted from the soya bean. It is one of the most effective stimulators of Hyaluronic Acid in cells in the dermal layer of skin and has been proven to increase Hyaluronic Acid production by up to 256% on cell level*.

* Study report: Saponins – a new generation of Hyaluronan-stimulating actives for human skin, S. Gallinat, F. Rippke, C. Keppler, J. Mergell, A. Bürger, F. Stäb, H.Wenck Beiersdorf AG, Hamburg, Germany

Learn More
Enoxolone

Enoxolone, also known as Glycyrrhetinic Acid, is derived from the roots of Glycyrrhiza glabra (liquorice plant) and is well known in traditional Chinese medicine. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid with anti‑inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. 

Enoxolone helps preserve levels of Hyaluronic Acid and elastin by protecting them against enzymatic degradation by hyaluronidase, and supports the skin’s own repair mechanisms against UV‑induced DNA damage.

FAQ

How do I know if Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect is the right anti-ageing range for me?

The Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect range has been specially formulated to counteract the first signs of ageing such as fine lines and deeper wrinkles. While our skin is as individual as we are, and skin ages differently depending on our genetics and lifestyle, these signs normally start to appear around the age of 30. The products in the Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect range work to counteract the ageing process by plumping up deep wrinkles for visibly smoother and firmer-looking skin.

If your primary skin concern is sagging skin, as well as loss of volume, the Hyaluron-Filler Epigenetics Serum has been specially formulated to plump up deep wrinkles and hydrate your skin. The powerful active ingredient Epicelline® reactivates the skin’s youth genes at the root and makes skin cells behave younger.

If skin elasticity and deepening wrinkles are your primary concern (most common for those over 50), we recommend the Hyaluron-Filler +Elasticity range.

Learn more about effective anti-ageing skincare routine for daily.

At what age should I start using the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler anti-ageing line?

Our skin is as different as we are, so the answer to that question varies from person to person and depends on many factors, both internal (such as genetics) and external (such as the amount of sun our skin has been exposed to). As a general rule, the first signs of ageing such as fine lines and wrinkles start to appear in our 30s, and that is when we recommend you start using the Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect range. If you are in any doubt,  read our article on skin at different ages or consult a pharmacist or dermatologist.

Why does Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Day Care SPF 30 contain UVB and UVA protection?

The sun’s UVA and UVB rays affect skin in different ways. UVA rays are most commonly associated with photoageing (premature skin ageing caused by the sun) as they contribute to the breakdown of skin components such as Hyaluronic Acid, collagen, and elastin, which are key to the firmness and elasticity of the skin. UVB rays can cause immediate damage such as sunburn and long-term damage like skin cancer. Read more in our article on how the sun’s rays affect skin.

Facial skin is frequently exposed to both types of UV, even on cloudy days. That’s why Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Day Care SPF 30 includes both UVA and UVB protection.

If you’re looking for additional sun protection, follow your Eucerin Day Care product with Eucerin Photoageing Control Sun Fluid SPF 50.

Will this help reduce fine lines and wrinkles for younger-looking skin?

Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Day Care SPF 30 for all skin types has a unique combination of high and low molecular Hyaluronic Acid, Glycine Saponin, and Enoxolone that smooths fine lines and even plumps up deep wrinkles for a rejuvenated look.

Does this anti-ageing moisturiser suit all skin types?

Hyaluron-Filler +3x Effect Day Care SPF 30 effectively hydrates and smooths all skin types.
